title: In Edit Labor, a former technician on the line is grayed out in name order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two new technicians for this test, staff member B and staff member C, enrolled at the test location, one with a name that sorts before staff member A's and one after, so the list has names to order around staff member A.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in Approved, led by staff member B, with one approved line, line 1, so the line belongs to someone else's work order.
  • Have staff member A, a technician for this test (Parts Manager role, Time Clock on, Technician on, enrolled at the test location only), on line 1 of work order 1 with a labor entry, added with Add Labor, and then switch staff member A's Technician off (and save the warning), so they are on the line but no longer a technician.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open Edit Labor for line 1.
  3. Click staff member A's tick.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens and line 1 still lists staff member A.

Step 2:

  • Staff member A is listed grayed out, the same as a deactivated technician today.
  • The list is in name order, so staff member A sits between staff member B and staff member C.

Step 3:

  • Staff member A stays ticked: they cannot be unticked there.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S3-R8: “Someone already on a line who is not offered per S3-R1 stays on the line. In the Edit Labor technician list they show grayed out, the same as a deactivated technician today; that list is in name order, so they appear among the others alphabetically, and they cannot be unticked there. In Edit Line they show as an ordinary chip that can be removed with its X, unless they have logged time on the line, in which case the chip shows the existing lock and "This technician has logged time on the line and cannot be removed.", as today. Saving a line's technicians in Edit Line keeps a person who is no longer a technician on the line unless the user removed them. As today, saving also drops a person from the line who has a labor entry on the work order but is not in the location's Time Clock list (deactivated, Time Clock off, on the built-in Office User or Time Clock User role, or not enrolled at the location) and has no time logged on that line; such a person who is on the line only through Add Technician, with no labor entry, stays.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "6 Technician dropdowns on a work order", picture "Add Technician on a line" (This build)

  • “Not offered: Parth Fadadu follows Nikola Milosevic. Add Labor uses the same list.”
  • “Anyone already on a line who is not a technician any more stays on it and shows grayed out, the same as a deactivated technician today.”

The caption says "Add Labor uses the same list."; the PRD names the Edit Labor window (register TT-D03, settled by S3-R6). The Edit Labor window is not drawn (register TT-N10).
